tasks.goal: Propose core.py with clamp_int(value, minimum, maximum). Accept only strict ints, reject booleans/non-ints with TypeError, reversed bounds with ValueError. Return the value clamped to the inclusive bounds. No imports or tools; one Python source block, at most 150 lines.
acceptance_criteria: Strict integer validation and inclusive bounds

tasks.goal: Write app.py and README.md while the worker prepares core.py. The JSON stdin CLI accepts exactly value,min,max, calls clamp_int and writes a JSON object containing value. Invalid input exits 2 without traceback. The CLI must work under python -I -B; explicitly add the application directory to sys.path before importing core. Save the worker final reply verbatim as worker-proposal.txt and integrate its source once.
acceptance_criteria: Valid JSON output for valid inputs
